WITH major_shares AS (
    SELECT
        m.major_id,
        m.department,
        COUNT(mem.member_id) AS member_count,
        1.0 * COUNT(mem.member_id) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(mem.member_id)) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM major AS m
    LEFT JOIN member AS mem
        ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
    GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department
),
with_department_avg AS (
    SELECT
        major_id,
        department,
        member_count,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS department_avg_share
    FROM major_shares
)
SELECT
    major_id,
    department,
    member_count,
    share,
    share - department_avg_share AS above_department_average
FROM with_department_avg
WHERE share > department_avg_share
ORDER BY above_department_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
